reviewDecisions.rationale: A previously closed monetization/approval channel reopened after eight months; direct company benefit depends on approved titles and existing economics.
An eight-week physical price turn plus prior breeding-capacity contraction can reset producer earnings; company cost/scale and expectation absorption must be checked.
A broad input-cost reversal can transfer margins downstream, but pass-through heterogeneity requires company-level proof.
The order cliff is economically material as a risk/filter event; positive expressions, if any, must be independently proven rather than assumed.
